name: @atta/dsh-atta
description: Atta v1.2 — DSH headless modeling plugin: recipes / Spec v3 / assemblies -> numpy + Blender -> measured facts -> three-state verify -> GLB/OBJ/STL/BLEND (+STEP subset). Ten atta_* tools, no GUI.
//why: Repository-root install shim, NOT the plugin package. The plugin lives in plugin/ (that manifest owns lib, skills and the bundle patch). DSH's plugin manager installs a git URL and then requires the INSTALLED package to declare dsh.bundle; a repo root without package.json installs as a placeholder (@laszapens/atta@0.0.0) and is refused with 'not-a-bundle' — '这个包没有声明组合包，不能作为插件管理'. This shim names the same package and points dsh.bundle/main at plugin/, so `dsh plugin add https://github.com/laszapens/Atta.git` works on the plain repo URL. Keep name/version in sync with plugin/package.json; plugin/test/smoke.mjs asserts it.
//private: true so only plugin/ is ever published to npm (npm publish from the repo root must not push a second copy of the same name@version). Git installs still work: private only blocks publishing.
//dsh.client: Deliberately ABSENT, same reason as plugin/package.json: declaring dsh.client makes dsh-client-modules demand exports["./client"] and throw MissingClientBundleError during Web boot. Atta has no browser half.
//peerDependenciesMeta: Same optional-peer set as plugin/package.json: the host may ship cordis/schemastery under either the scoped or the unscoped name, and the plugin resolves them at runtime, degrading to atta_plugin_status instead of failing to import.
